responsibility: Implements the core runtime support for GCC’s GIMPLE statement IR. This file owns the concrete statement-allocation and initialization machinery, maps gimple codes to structure classes and printable names generated from gimple.def, provides the main constructors and mutators for tuples such as assignments, returns, calls, switches, and sequences, maintains allocation statistics, and contains common utility routines for statement locations, alias information, operand cleanup, and other low-level properties that middle-end passes consume when creating, inspecting, or updating GIMPLE.
same_name_distinction: Core implementation file for GIMPLE runtime support: it defines allocation, initialization, constructors, mutators, utility routines, and the tables generated from gimple.def; unlike gcc/gimple.h it is not the inline/public API surface, and unlike gcc/gimple.def it is not the declarative code list.
